messages.subject: Project Quartz - W&I policy inception
messages.plaintextBody:
Rohan,

We're targeting completion on 13 February. To confirm for the policy: Sellers' SPA cap is 10% of consideration (£3,875,000); the buyer relies on the W&I tower above the de minimis (£25,000) and basket (£250,000). Two specific items for your underwriting note: the outstanding Northstar change-of-control consent and the open HMRC R&D enquiry (FY2023). Both will be in the disclosure letter.

Premium as quoted, £168,000 including IPT, payable from the funds flow at completion. Can you confirm you can incept on 13 Feb?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James - confirmed, we can incept on 13 February on receipt of the signed SPA, disclosure letter and the buyer's NBI declaration. The Northstar consent and R&D enquiry are noted as specific disclosures; they sit within the policy's general exclusions for matters known to the buyer, as usual. Premium £168,000 incl. IPT.

Rohan Mistry
Aldgate Specialty (Underwriting) Ltd
